CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible BIBLE? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible BIBLE has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Bible BIBLE to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible BIBLE.

3. Which response best shows understanding of God as the CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Use God as the CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God as the CREATION.
   C. Apply the teaching of God as the CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say God as the CREATION has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Plants and CREATION to; to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.

   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

9. A — Apply the teaching of Communicating to with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
